subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with details be hidden before mutating-tool handling, or should cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, timeout, and unacknowledged success-mismatch contexts continue surfacing visible exec warnings?
rationale: Current tests and mutation handling preserve visible exec warnings in several detail-bearing contexts, while this PR asserts they should always be suppressed; code review cannot choose that product policy safely.

options.title: Preserve Visible Failure Contexts
options.body: Keep visible warnings for mutating, timeout, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec failures, then narrow or replace the linked issue and branch accordingly.

options.title: Suppress Exec-Like First
options.body: Move exec-like suppression ahead of mutating handling and update the conflicting tests to make suppress-all behavior the explicit contract.

options.title: Split Benign From Risky Exec Failures
options.body: Suppress only recovered or clearly benign non-mutating exec failures while retaining warnings for timeouts, unacknowledged success claims, and contexts with no other useful failure detail.

recommendation.title: Preserve Visible Failure Contexts
recommendation.body: Keep visible warnings for mutating, timeout, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec failures, then narrow or replace the linked issue and branch accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans payload policy, user-visible warning behavior, and adjacent agent runtime ownership where steipete has repeated recent history.
